allowed_content: selected relevant decision checks and missing-information handling
excluded_content: historical approval or completion copied into current-ticket facts

global_guards: Apply current operational emergency and authority rules before any playbook.
Unknown current prerequisites remain unknown; historical examples cannot populate ticket state.
Choose at most one next business action per MCP invocation.
Only existing agent tools can be proposed; messages and dispatches are simulated in the current agent.
No physical repair, attachment interpretation, payment, calendar booking or database update capability is added by these files.

playbooks.title: Supported tenant checks and confirmed resolution
playbooks.trigger: A routine issue has a specific, supported, non-invasive check or an explicitly permitted tenant action.
exclusions: An emergency or unresolved security risk.
A check has already failed, is unsafe, requires professional work, or has no applicable current basis.
Liability or tenant charging has not been established by current authoritative terms.

steps.when: A safe applicable check is evidenced and has not already been tried.
steps.next_action: Ask the tenant to perform that check and report the result. Do not copy equipment layout or liability from a historical example.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Ask for the specific missing fact; use ordinary triage if no supported check exists.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Identify the exact current instruction and its source; check whether it was already tried and whether the ticket reports a safety issue.
communication_requirements: Ask only for the evidenced check and its result; do not invent an equipment location, technical procedure or liability.

steps.when: A response to the check is still pending.
steps.next_action: Wait for the tenant; do not claim success.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Obtain a result before moving to resolution.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Find the earlier successful request and check for a later tenant result.
communication_requirements: If the current policy requires a chase, address the unanswered check; otherwise hold for the tenant.
steps.wait_for: The answer to the specific check.

steps.when: The tenant says the check failed or the problem recurred.
steps.next_action: Move to approved professional assessment using PB03, or the currently applicable ownership route.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Resolve authorization before dispatch.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Find the failed attempt; separate a repeated identical check from a different currently supported one.
communication_requirements: Request approval for professional assessment when needed; do not repeat a failed check or dispatch under historical approval.
steps.wait_for: Current scope approval or the active owner response.

steps.when: The tenant confirms the specific problem is resolved and no material risk remains.
steps.next_action: Apply PB12 before closing; record any recurrence or monitoring condition.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Request the outstanding completion evidence.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Match the tenant confirmation to the original problem; identify any outstanding in-scope obligation.
communication_requirements: Use the truthful no-work disposition only after applicable PB12 checks.

representative_examples.summary: The landlord identified the extractor switch; the tenant then confirmed the fan worked.
Dishwasher checks preceded engineer attendance; the check did not establish resolution.

evidence_limits: Four primary cases report tenant resolution; three additional cases support the failed-check branch.
A historical instruction is not a universal repair method.
playbooks.update_policy: Update this playbook version after source and operational review. Do not create a searchable record for each ticket.

playbooks.title: Landlord managed repair
playbooks.trigger: The landlord explicitly takes responsibility for arranging the repair or uses their own contractor.
exclusions: Responsibility is only assumed.
Concurrent agency and landlord assignments are unresolved.

steps.when: The current landlord explicitly elects to manage the work.
steps.next_action: Record the owner and ask for the plan or completion update; do not open a competing instruction.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Clarify who is responsible.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Find an explicit current landlord commitment to arrange the work; approval for agency attendance alone is not this commitment.
communication_requirements: Ask the landlord for the arrangement or completion update without opening a second contractor instruction.

Do not promise that the landlord or their own provider will contact the tenant directly unless the current arrangement explicitly confirms that. State only that the landlord is checking the date, which remains unconfirmed; the agency can promise its own update only.
steps.wait_for: The landlord plan or completion report.

steps.when: The landlord-managed work is pending.
steps.next_action: Wait or request a progress update according to the configured chase policy.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Do not infer a visit date or chase interval from repeated historic holds.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Identify the active owner, last response and any promised milestone; apply only the configured chase policy.
communication_requirements: Ask the landlord about the pending milestone, not a provider the agency never instructed.

Do not promise that the landlord or their own provider will contact the tenant directly unless the current arrangement explicitly confirms that. State only that the landlord is checking the date, which remains unconfirmed; the agency can promise its own update only.

steps.when: The first attempt failed or another contractor becomes involved.
steps.next_action: Clarify the active owner and remaining scope before switching the route.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Resolve any conflicting assignments.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Identify who now owns the remaining job; distinguish tenant coordination with the owner provider from a request for agency dispatch.
communication_requirements: Confirm transfer of responsibility and any current approval before assigning a competing provider.

steps.when: A credible current report confirms the in-scope work is complete.
steps.next_action: Apply PB12; keep unrelated unfinished work separate.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Request completion confirmation for this issue.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Check who observed the result, which item was repaired and what remains; a landlord promise is not a result.
communication_requirements: Ask only for outstanding PB12 checks; do not request approval again for completed work.
steps.wait_for: Missing completion evidence or final checks.

The landlord arranged further washing-machine repair after an unsuccessful attempt; a towel-rail issue remained separate.

playbooks.title: Agency arranged assessment and repair
playbooks.trigger: A repair or professional assessment is needed and the agency is the active coordinator.
exclusions: An emergency requires human handling under current policy.
A different owner, warranty route, or unresolved material identity conflict applies.

steps.when: The property, affected item, risk and responsibility are sufficiently clear.
steps.next_action: Assess current permission and scope; use PB09 or PB11 where they are unclear.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Resolve the fact that changes dispatch or authorization.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Check property identity, item, risk, active coordinator and the exact fact that would change the action.
communication_requirements: Ask a focused question only when its answer changes trade, scope, authority or safety; do not ask for an already supplied location.

steps.when: The needed visit or expenditure is not currently authorized.
steps.next_action: Request approval for the actual proposed scope and any evidenced cost.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Do not use approval from a source case.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Identify the proposed attendance and the actual current approval; a request, a reply or a vague positive response is not necessarily approval of this scope.
communication_requirements: State the current scope and known cost, or explicitly state that the cost is unknown.

steps.when: Current authorization covers the proposed attendance and scope.
steps.next_action: Assign the appropriate trade and give only verified current instructions.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Clarify the authorization boundary.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Match current permission to the attendance, trade, work, cost and conditions; verify the landlord is not managing it themselves.
communication_requirements: Limit contractor notes to the authorized scope, known current contact details and quotation boundary.

steps.when: A provider is instructed but attendance is pending.
steps.next_action: Apply PB10 for booking, access, changes and missed visits.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Obtain the unresolved booking or access information.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Determine whether the provider has actually been instructed and which booking or access field is missing.
communication_requirements: Ask the responsible party for that missing field using PB10.
steps.wait_for: A confirmed appointment or access arrangement.

steps.when: Assessment changes the work, risk or cost beyond authorization.
steps.next_action: Apply PB09 before authorizing the changed work.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Obtain the missing quote or scope.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Compare the new work and total charge with the approved version; separate assessment permission from repair permission.
communication_requirements: Do not instruct additional work before the PB09 scope and cost checks are satisfied.
steps.wait_for: A complete quote and approval for the changed proposal.

steps.when: The provider reports repair, no repair needed, or incomplete work.
steps.next_action: Verify the applicable result; apply PB11 and PB12 before closure.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Do not equate a status update with verified completion.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Match the report to the correct property and job; distinguish repair, no work required and unfinished work.
communication_requirements: Verify remaining work and PB12 requirements instead of closing from a generic completion label.

representative_examples.summary: The landlord approved contractor attendance for a flush mechanism, then approved a specific replacement quote.
After attendance, the provider reported that the door had settled and no repair or invoice was required.

Technical repairs remain provider work. Source cases 048 and 050 contain material identity conflicts.

playbooks.title: Checkout cleaning and coordinated works
playbooks.trigger: A checkout request needs a scoped estimate, cleaning, or multiple coordinated works.
exclusions: A vacant property is treated as ordinary occupied-tenant access.
Deposit liability, deductions or payment authority are inferred from historical practice.

steps.when: The checkout request or report defines the proposed work.
steps.next_action: Obtain the available report and distinguish requested, quoted and approved items.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Request the missing scope or report instead of inventing its contents.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Check which report contents are actually available and whether carpets or other items are included in the requested work.
communication_requirements: Ask for the missing report or scope; do not reconstruct an unavailable attachment.

steps.when: A quote is available but the selected scope is not authorized.
steps.next_action: Request approval, including any requested comparison quote, through PB09.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Clarify price, selected quote or included work.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Match the selected quote, included items, price and tax basis to the landlord reply; check for a withdrawn or revised quote.
communication_requirements: Name the competing quotes and ask which exact scope and total is approved when the reply cannot resolve it.

steps.when: Cleaning or other work depends on another task finishing.
steps.next_action: Verify the predecessor is complete and agree a consistent schedule before instruction.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Resolve inconsistent dates and dependency status.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Identify each predecessor and actual completion evidence; check whether proposed dates permit the required order.
communication_requirements: Confirm the predecessor or reconcile dates before confirming dependent cleaning.
steps.wait_for: Predecessor completion and a consistent schedule.

steps.when: Approved work can proceed.
steps.next_action: Coordinate keys, caretaker access or the verified access arrangement using PB10.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Follow the configured vacant-property policy and obtain access details.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Check current consent, vacancy policy and verified key or caretaker arrangements; key possession alone is not consent.
communication_requirements: Request the missing access arrangement; apply the current vacant-property rule.
steps.wait_for: Current access permission and practical arrangements.

steps.when: Work is reported finished.
steps.next_action: Reconcile changes against approved scope and apply PB12 for keys, invoice and confirmation.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Request outstanding evidence; payment is a separate fact.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Compare reported work with the approved items and total; check actual keys return and invoice availability.
communication_requirements: Request outstanding evidence rather than inferring payment from an invoice or receipt from a request.

representative_examples.summary: A checkout clean waited for other checkout works; later schedule wording was inconsistent and needs confirmation.
A comparison quote was requested; the final invoice was lower because a tap did not need replacing.

evidence_limits: Missing photos, unclear invoices and inconsistent dates must not become automatic acceptance rules.

playbooks.title: Garden scope responsibility and completion evidence
playbooks.trigger: A request concerns communal vegetation, tenant garden maintenance, or garden clearance.
exclusions: Boundary, responsibility or disposal requirements are assumed.
A request for clearing is treated as approval for every landscaping item.

steps.when: The affected area, requested work and responsible party are clear.
steps.next_action: Separate communal work, landlord-managed work and tenant-maintenance follow-up. Route execution through PB01, PB02 or PB03 as applicable.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Clarify the material scope or responsibility gap.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Identify the affected garden area, requested task and current basis for responsibility; separate communal and tenant areas.
communication_requirements: Ask only for the boundary or responsibility that changes routing; do not copy liability from another case.
steps.wait_for: A material scope or responsibility clarification.

steps.when: The contractor identifies additional material or disposal requirements.
steps.next_action: Obtain and submit the revised scope and quote using PB09.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Resolve changed cost and included work.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Compare approved clearance with new material, disposal or additional tasks and the revised total.
communication_requirements: Ask for the revised itemized scope and quote, then current approval.

steps.when: The responsible party is carrying out the agreed task.
steps.next_action: Track progress or request the specifically needed completion evidence.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: A promise to send a photo is not completion evidence.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Distinguish a plan, a completion claim and supplied completion evidence.
communication_requirements: Ask the responsible party for the outstanding result or evidence without claiming an unseen photo was checked.

steps.when: Current evidence supports completion of the agreed scope.
steps.next_action: Apply PB12. Keep uncleared or unapproved items open.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Do not infer gravel, levelling or other unconfirmed work from a clearance report.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Check whether reported clearance also establishes any separately promised gravel, levelling or disposal.
communication_requirements: Keep unconfirmed in-scope items open and apply PB12 to the verified result.

playbooks.title: Warranty and remedial repair
playbooks.trigger: A recently supplied item or a previous repair may have warranty or remedial coverage.
exclusions: Coverage or a free repair is assumed from age alone.
Conflicting warranty terms are resolved by choosing the most convenient statement.

steps.when: Warranty or defective recent work is credibly raised.
steps.next_action: Ask the installer, supplier or provider to verify current coverage and the responsible route.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Obtain coverage and cost confirmation.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Identify the item, installer or supplier, claimed coverage and whether current coverage and charges have actually been confirmed.
communication_requirements: Ask the responsible provider to confirm the applicable coverage route and any charge before promising a free repair.

steps.when: Coverage reports disagree or attendance dates are inconsistent.
steps.next_action: Escalate a material conflict under the current policy, identifying the coverage or charge decision needed.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Keep coverage and booking unknown until resolved.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: List the incompatible current coverage or charge statements; a later statement without a coverage basis does not automatically settle the contradiction.
communication_requirements: Escalate a material conflict under the current policy, identifying the coverage or charge decision needed.
steps.wait_for: An authoritative resolution of coverage and charge.

steps.when: The responsible provider confirms the route and any cost.
steps.next_action: Coordinate attendance and parts through PB10; use PB09 if a charge falls outside approval.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Resolve any charge or access prerequisite.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Verify the responsible provider and current charge status; distinguish warranty permission from permission for extra paid work.
communication_requirements: Coordinate the confirmed route; request approval for any proposed charge outside current permission.
steps.wait_for: Attendance, parts delivery or revised charge approval.

steps.when: The warranty or remedial provider reports completion.
steps.next_action: Confirm the result and charge status, then apply PB12.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Do not treat ordered parts as completed repair.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Separate ordered parts and expected repair dates from an actual completed repair and final no-charge confirmation.
communication_requirements: Request the missing result or charge evidence before PB12 closure.
steps.wait_for: The actual repair result and final charge status.

playbooks.title: Tenant supplied replacement and property ownership
playbooks.trigger: The tenant offers or has installed their own replacement for a landlord-provided appliance.
exclusions: Tenant possession is treated as permission to remove or dispose of landlord property.
Safe installation is inferred despite missing isolation or professional access details.

steps.when: Replacement is proposed but responsibilities are not settled.
steps.next_action: Ask the landlord to settle the outstanding landlord-property disposition and departure ownership terms. Tenant intentions already stated need no repeat question; a tenant reply cannot establish landlord consent.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Route permission and ownership questions to the landlord. If material terms require human judgement, escalate naming each unresolved term; do not confirm the proposal.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Identify consent for replacement, who owns the new item on departure, old-item storage or disposal, installation and charges; consent to use an item does not answer all these questions.

Distinguish the tenant proposal from the landlord decision. A known tenant intention to remove an item or take their own item on departure leaves landlord consent unresolved, not the tenant intention.
communication_requirements: Address the landlord when old landlord property disposition or departure agreement is unresolved. Specify both terms when both are open. Do not ask the tenant to approve, decide or reconfirm landlord-controlled terms.
Ask the tenant only for a genuinely missing tenant intention or factual detail; state that landlord agreement is still required.
Escalation is an alternative when a person must resolve the agreement; name the old-item disposition and departure arrangement without inventing a dispute.
steps.wait_for: Explicit agreement on the material unresolved terms.

steps.when: The tenant reports a replacement was already installed.
steps.next_action: Record what happened and resolve remaining permission, safety, storage and communication issues.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Do not backdate approval or assume all follow-up is finished.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Separate the reported installation from recorded consent and any promised inspection or storage arrangement.
communication_requirements: Address the current unresolved agreement or promised inspection; do not backdate consent or treat a working replacement as completing the old-item task.
steps.wait_for: Remaining agreement, inspection or storage confirmation.

steps.when: The current agreement and relevant completion facts are confirmed.
steps.next_action: Apply PB12, retaining unresolved appliance inspection or storage matters.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Resolve outstanding follow-up before final closure.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Check the current agreement and all in-scope follow-up; separate tenant-owned replacement from landlord asset disposition.
communication_requirements: Use PB12 only when the remaining inspection or storage obligation is resolved or explicitly withdrawn.

representative_examples.summary: The landlord approved tenant ownership and removal arrangements; the tenant arranged disposal through a family member.
A tenant swapped machines before the inspection arrangement was settled; the landlord later still requested an update.

evidence_limits: Case 038 contains inconsistent property addresses; only the generic agreement structure is retained.
Case 040 is a cautionary example, not evidence that unapproved replacement or early closure is acceptable.

playbooks.title: Reading requests and inspection reports
playbooks.trigger: The task is collecting a reading, scheduling an inspection, or delivering a report rather than authorizing repair.

steps.when: The requested reading or evidence is missing.
steps.next_action: Ask for the specific readable evidence and wait for delivery.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: A promise to supply evidence does not satisfy delivery.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative

steps.when: An inspection needs scheduling or a change.
steps.next_action: Confirm date, access and relevant pet arrangements with PB10.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Resolve conflicting dates or access before confirming.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative

communication_requirements: Ask only for the missing booking field using PB10.

steps.when: The report or reading is actually available.
steps.next_action: Send the available information to the intended recipient and verify the applicable acknowledgement.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Do not invent readings or unseen report findings.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative

communication_requirements: Transmit only available content and request acknowledgement when current policy requires it.

steps.next_action: Record and route the separate matter; do not reinterpret the completed report as addressing it.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Clarify separate scope where necessary.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Determine whether the new request belongs to the inspection or constitutes a separate task.
communication_requirements: Record the separate task without claiming the earlier report resolved it.
steps.wait_for: A separate scope decision if necessary.

playbooks.title: Scope quote and approval boundaries
playbooks.trigger: Approval is missing, limited, ambiguous, or a quote changes the proposed work or expenditure.
exclusions: A historical amount becomes a universal spending limit.
Permission for inspection is treated as permission for every repair.

steps.when: Current approval does not cover the proposed action.
steps.next_action: Request the exact scope and known cost; identify missing quote information.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Do not dispatch chargeable work under unknown permission.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Check the approval source, exact scope, amount and conditions; no reply or an approval request cannot establish consent.
communication_requirements: Request approval for the actual proposal and known cost; request quote details first if the proposal cannot be specified.

steps.when: Approval permits only simple work or imposes a condition.
steps.next_action: Keep the instruction within that boundary; obtain a quote and further permission for parts or complexity outside it.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Clarify non-numeric limits instead of inventing a threshold.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Separate attendance, diagnosis, minor repair and replacement permissions; preserve any condition exactly as recorded.
communication_requirements: Limit instructions to the approved activity. Obtain a quote and renewed approval for excluded parts or complexity; do not invent a numeric limit for words such as inexpensive.
steps.wait_for: A quote or clarification of the actual limit.

steps.when: A changed quote, risk or scope is reported.
steps.next_action: If the quote total, included work or tax basis is incomplete, first ask the contractor for a complete comparable quote. Only once those facts are known, request landlord approval for the changed scope and total.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Send the missing-quote question to its source, the contractor. Do not substitute a landlord approval request with an unknown final total; escalate if human resolution is required.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Compare current and approved scope, quote version, amount and tax basis; an untaxed figure is not comparable to a tax-inclusive cap until its basis is known.
A budget ceiling is not repair approval. If only inspection is approved, repair remains unapproved even when the eventual quote falls below the budget.

Resolve the quote facts before requesting approval. The next action is a contractor clarification while the total is unknown; it is a landlord approval request only after a complete total is available.
communication_requirements: For known excess, request approval of the complete changed proposal. If the total or included work is unknown, ask the contractor for the missing amount or scope before claiming the cap is met.

Describe the amount as the landlord budget ceiling, not approval for repair. Tell the contractor the inspection alone is approved and replacement needs separate permission; requesting the final total does not authorize starting.
Do not infer VAT, a tax rate or the final total from a generic tax reference. Ask the provider to confirm their actual all-inclusive total.
steps.wait_for: A comparable complete total and explicit approval when required.

steps.when: Several quotes or multiple work items are under discussion.
steps.next_action: Confirm which quote and items were approved; retain the approved version.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: An unspecified yes is insufficient when its referent changes the action.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Identify each live quote and included item; check whether the reply names a version and whether an earlier quote was withdrawn.
communication_requirements: Ask the landlord which exact quote, items and total they approve; do not choose a cheaper or newer version from an ambiguous yes.

A disposal requirement changed the garden quote and prompted renewed landlord approval.

playbooks.title: Booking access and disrupted attendance
playbooks.trigger: A visit needs scheduling, verified access, rescheduling, parts delivery, or a missed-visit response.
exclusions: Permission to enter is inferred merely because a management key exists.
A synthetic date or repeated reminder becomes a universal timer policy.

steps.when: An approved provider needs access and an appointment.
steps.next_action: Ask for the required contact, access, key and time arrangements using verified current details.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Resolve the specific access gap; do not ask for already-known facts.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Check appointment, tenant availability, current consent for entry, key source and provider contact; distinguish key availability from permission to enter.
communication_requirements: Ask the party who can resolve the missing field. Do not promise key entry when consent is missing or attendance when the windows do not overlap.
steps.wait_for: A viable appointment and current access permission.

steps.when: Recorded dates or time slots disagree.
steps.next_action: Confirm the authoritative appointment with the relevant parties before sending a definitive confirmation.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Do not silently choose one historic date representation.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Compare absolute dates, relative wording and time-window overlap without selecting an unsupported interpretation.
communication_requirements: Escalate a material conflict under current policy or obtain authoritative clarification when policy allows; do not confirm an impossible appointment.

steps.when: The provider missed a confirmed appointment or awaits parts.
steps.next_action: Obtain the revised plan and inform the tenant; wait for actual attendance or result.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Do not mark parts ordered or tomorrow's visit as completed.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Identify the confirmed missed visit or parts delay; check for a revised date or actual later attendance.
communication_requirements: Ask the provider for the missing revised plan; if the plan is already known, relay only that verified plan to the tenant.

steps.when: An answer or visit remains pending.
steps.next_action: Use the configured operational reminder and escalation policy.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Use a real current clock and verified last-contact facts if timers are enabled.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Use the current policy, observed time, prior successful chases and latest outside response; do not count duplicate historical templates as agent chases.
communication_requirements: Hold or chase the responsible party when due; escalate at the configured boundary.
steps.wait_for: The outstanding answer or visit result.

representative_examples.summary: The tenant challenged the oven appointment date and the agency clarified the agreed booking.
A plumbing provider missed the confirmed date and the case awaited attendance the following day.

evidence_limits: Ten selected supporting cases illustrate booking conditions, not the prevalence of all scheduling events.
The current MCP records messages and holds but has no physical entry or independent calendar execution tool.

playbooks.title: Material identity and evidence conflicts
playbooks.trigger: A property, person, contact, provider or evidence item disagrees across records in a way that affects the next action.
exclusions: A stylistic difference that does not change identity or the decision is treated as a material conflict.
One field is chosen as authoritative solely because it is newer or repeated more often.

steps.when: Current evidence contains a material mismatch.
steps.next_action: Identify the conflicting fields and affected decision without choosing an unsupported canonical value.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Request authoritative confirmation.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Identify both conflicting values and the concrete next action they affect; cosmetic wording is not a material conflict.
communication_requirements: State the conflict without choosing a canonical value; apply the block step when it affects dispatch, recipient or closure.

steps.when: The mismatch affects recipient, dispatch, approval or completion.
steps.next_action: Escalate under the current material-conflict policy, naming both values and the single affected decision. Keep the disputed action unexecuted.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Do not send sensitive details or close a possibly different job.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Check whether dispatch, recipient, approval, invoice ownership or completion would depend on choosing a disputed value.
communication_requirements: Escalate under the current material-conflict policy, naming both values and the single affected decision. Keep the disputed action unexecuted.

steps.when: An authoritative current source resolves the mismatch.
steps.next_action: Record the resolution and return to the relevant playbook step.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: If no resolution arrives, preserve uncertainty and continue only unaffected work.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Find explicit current confirmation that resolves the named mismatch; frequency or recency alone is insufficient.
communication_requirements: Record the authoritative resolution and reassess the affected step.
steps.wait_for: Any remaining prerequisite in the relevant scenario.

evidence_limits: Ten selected cases contain explicit identity mismatches in the reviewed evidence. This is not a complete anomaly scan.
This module is a proposed corrective guard; the historical handling often did not demonstrate successful conflict resolution.

playbooks.title: Completion evidence keys invoices and remaining work
playbooks.trigger: A task is reported complete or is being considered for closure.
exclusions: A Completed label alone is treated as complete evidence.
An invoice implies payment, a promised key drop-off implies return, or an unavailable photo implies inspected content.

steps.when: A result is reported.
steps.next_action: Check identity, in-scope result and who actually confirmed it. Distinguish repaired, no work required and outstanding work.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Obtain the required current confirmation.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Check property and job identity, who observed the result, what was actually completed and remaining in-scope work.
communication_requirements: Ask for the missing specific completion fact; use PB11 for a material identity conflict.

steps.when: Keys were issued or new keys are owed.
steps.next_action: Verify actual return or delivery; a future promise does not satisfy it.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Keep keys outstanding until confirmed.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Identify issued or newly owed keys and actual return evidence; tomorrow or will drop off describes a future promise.
communication_requirements: If the return is still promised, hold for the provider or request confirmation when due. Do not mark keys returned or not issued.

steps.when: A charge or invoice is relevant.
steps.next_action: Confirm the required invoice status or an evidenced no-charge exception; keep payment separate.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Ask for the missing document or cost confirmation.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Distinguish invoice receipt, a request for it, expected future delivery and an explicit no-charge statement for the current job.
communication_requirements: Ask the contractor for the missing invoice or charge confirmation; do not assume payment or waive the invoice because the work is reported done.
steps.wait_for: Invoice on file or an evidenced applicable no-charge exception.

steps.when: A linked issue, promised inspection or material follow-up remains.
steps.next_action: Separate the scope and resolve outstanding obligations before declaring the whole case finished.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Do not close the unresolved issue by inheriting another task's success.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Identify unresolved items in the same agreed task, promised inspections and separate unrelated requests.
communication_requirements: Obtain the remaining in-scope evidence; record unrelated work separately without inventing a completed inspection.
steps.wait_for: Outstanding in-scope work or an explicit withdrawal.

steps.when: All checks required by current policy are evidenced for this task.
steps.next_action: Close using the truthful disposition and current confirmation, landlord-awareness, key and invoice fields.
steps.if_required_information_is_missing: Keep the case pending or escalate if a required check cannot be established.
steps.guard_status: reference guidance; current policy and tool guards remain authoritative
decision_checks: Verify all current-policy closure fields: observed result, landlord awareness, actual key status and invoice or no-charge basis.
communication_requirements: Populate close_case from current evidence only; unresolved required fields prevent closure.
